verified: Public ungated artifact repository and two upload commits are independently visible; repository dates do not establish manuscript publication or peer review.
The card names the project and links upstream LeWM, DINO-WM, PlaNet, TD-MPC2 and DreamerV3 resources, but supplies no linked paper or project attack-code repository.
The only included Python file verifies manifest sizes and checksums. It is not an attack, planner, causal evaluation, or environment replay implementation.
The manifest contains locally trained RGB TD-MPC2, DreamerV3, LeWM HGD defense artifact paths; declared checkpoint authenticity/parity was not independently tested.

The author-linked GitHub account has 32 public repositories at inspection. Two attack/security-named roots were checked: active_attacks documents LLM red-teaming; MLSecCL contains active_attacks. Neither inspected root documents this project.
not_located: An exact-title arXiv/OpenReview paper, manuscript version, author list, accepted venue, quantitative results, or public research loader/evaluation repository in this bounded search.
A specified attacker control channel, norm/budget/knowledge permissions, protected inputs, or a verified forecast-to-action-to-real-utility causal evaluation.
An executable matched fixed-state/fixed-candidate/true-environment-utility evaluation supplied by this release.
limits: Not found in the inspected public sources is not proof that a paper, private code or another public repository does not exist. HGD/eps16 filenames alone do not establish an observation attack, threat model or mechanism.

overlap.DINO: Same model family only is established. Our native copied-action-request executor-equivalent canonicalization result is not shown to be covered by the unavailable attack methods. Our one-root lower return coexists with improved success and true-future proxy mismatch.
overlap.TD_MPC2: Their inventory describes locally trained RGB task checkpoints. Our source23 dynamics adaptation uses a different source-data/update interface and state-based multitask resource. No mechanism equivalence is established.
overlap.SafeDreamer: Their release lists DreamerV3 rather than SafeDreamer OSRP; no verified safety-mode or cross-candidate-noise coupling method is described. Our fixed mode mediator gate measured safe counts462/449, no crossing, no environment action or task harm.
overlap.general: Frozen world-model planner robustness and decision misranking are overlapping research themes. No priority/novelty conclusion follows from the title or artifact list alone.

decision: Not currently a demonstrated drop-in causal evaluation resource. Preserve as an artifact-release lead; require a primary manuscript plus corresponding attack/evaluation implementation before treating its threat model/results as verified prior art or allocating weight downloads.
